identity.name: Chronomètre Souverain
identity.one_liner: F.P. Journe's first series-production watch (2005, in production since the brand's 1999 founding), in a 40mm platinum case with a brass movement. The reference that made independent watchmaking serious.

provenance_events.description: The Chronomètre Souverain is the watch that establishes F.P. Journe's reputation in the secondary market: a 40mm case, ruthenium or silver dial, and the in-house calibre 1304 with twin barrels. The 2021 "Holland & Holland" Damascus-dial limited edition sold 28 pieces at Phillips for charity.

narrative.story: The Chronomètre Souverain is F.P. Journe's most-produced watch. The 1304 caliber is brass (a deliberate choice — brass is softer and more serviceable than steel) with twin barrels and a constant-force escapement. The dial is silvered brass with small seconds at 7:30. The 40mm platinum case is the only metal in regular production; rose gold and steel are limited. The Chronomètre Souverain is the textbook F.P. Journe: hand-finished movement, small-batch production, six-figure waiting list, secondary market 2-3x retail.
